answer: Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The design leans on bond keyed to a hardware root, reset on any identity-link attempt. By the bridge of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The opal lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the zephyr is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
